title: drive halts the sprint on a gate-enforced deny the role recovered from
detail: drive escalates permission_denied on any denial in a spawn result. In junit-xml-evidence reviewing, the prusik writable gate correctly denied regression-sentinel's out-of-phase cp into the main tree; the sentinel recovered, captured the full suite in the worktree and wrote a valid PASS (verdict-current confirms). The sprint still stopped for the operator. Distinguish a prusik-gate deny (role attempted something its phase forbids; the gate already enforced it) from a platform permission denial (role lacked a needed permission). Keep failing closed for the latter; for the former, log the attempted action and let the verdict stand on its evidence, or escalate only when the role's verdict is missing.
